# Salary Negotiation Prep Skill for Muse

A full salary-negotiation playbook: research market rates from public sources (levels.fyi, Glassdoor, LinkedIn Salary, H1B data), build a percentile-based target range, calculate total compensation beyond base salary (bonus, equity, signing bonus, 401k, benefits), and prepare with ready-made counter-offer email and call scripts. It walks through five common scenarios — low first offer, being asked your expectations first, pushback on base, competing offers, being asked your salary history — plus a day-by-day negotiation timeline and an offer-comparison table. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: data sources and examples are US-centric (levels.fyi, RSUs, 401k match) — less directly useful for European or Québec compensation; this is negotiation strategy, not legal or financial advice. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
